__meta.description: Grafana dashboard for Autonomous AI Learning System - Prometheus datasource

setup_notes.metrics_exporter: Custom exporter should expose ai_learning_* metrics from learning.db

dashboard.title: Autonomous AI Learning System
dashboard.description: Real-time monitoring of multi-model AI orchestration: quality, cost, speed, model performance, parameter tuning, and fleet health. Prometheus datasource.

panels.title: LIS Score
panels.description: Learning Intelligence Score: composite 0-100 gauge. 40% quality + 20% success rate + 20% cost efficiency + 20% speed efficiency.

targets.expr:
clamp_max(
  (
    (avg(ai_learning_quality_score{model=~"$model", task_type=~"$task_type"}) or vector(0)) * 40
    + (avg(ai_learning_success_rate{model=~"$model", task_type=~"$task_type"}) or vector(0)) * 20
    + clamp_min(1 - (avg(ai_learning_cost_usd{model=~"$model", task_type=~"$task_type"}) / 0.50), 0) * 20
    + clamp_min(1 - (avg(ai_learning_duration_seconds{model=~"$model", task_type=~"$task_type"}) / 30), 0) * 20
  ),
  100
)

panels.title: LIS Score Trend
panels.description: LIS composite score over time. Tracks the learning system improvement trajectory.

targets.expr:
clamp_max(
  (
    (avg(avg_over_time(ai_learning_quality_score{model=~"$model", task_type=~"$task_type"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) * 40
    + (avg(avg_over_time(ai_learning_success_rate{model=~"$model", task_type=~"$task_type"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) * 20
    + clamp_min(1 - (avg(avg_over_time(ai_learning_cost_usd{model=~"$model", task_type=~"$task_type"}[$__rate_interval])) / 0.50), 0) * 20
    + clamp_min(1 - (avg(avg_over_time(ai_learning_duration_seconds{model=~"$model", task_type=~"$task_type"}[$__rate_interval])) / 30), 0) * 20
  ),
  100
)

panels.title: Quality Improvement
panels.description: Per-model quality trends plus ALL_MODELS dashed overlay. Tracks quality improvement over time.

panels.title: Cost Savings
panels.description: Dual-axis: daily total cost as bars + average cost per execution as trend line. USD currency units.

panels.title: Speed Improvement
panels.description: Dual-axis: average duration in seconds + cumulative seconds saved vs first-day baseline (dashed green).

panels.title: Learning Sessions
panels.description: Stacked bar chart of execution counts per interval, segmented by workflow type.

panels.title: Top Discoveries
panels.description: Table showing model tuning discoveries: optimal parameters, quality, cost, degradation status, and best worker combinations with synergy/diversity scores.

panels.title: Model Performance Heatmap
panels.description: Table with color-background cells: model x task_type showing quality (GrYlRd), win rate (blues), consensus (greens). Filterable and sortable.

panels.title: Research Activity
panels.description: Time series of research-related executions filtered by workflow/task_type containing research/web/learn. Includes fallback all-activity query.

panels.title: Parameter Tuning
panels.description: Optimal parameters discovered per model/task combination: temperature, top_p, max_tokens with quality impact.

panels.title: Temperature vs Quality Scatter
panels.description: XY scatter plot of temperature parameter against quality_score, colored by model. Identifies optimal parameter ranges.

panels.title: Fleet Health - Workload Distribution
panels.description: Donut pie chart of execution count per model. Legend as table with value and percent.

panels.title: Fleet Health - Error Rate
panels.description: Time series of error rate percentage per model. Thresholds at 5% (yellow) and 20% (red).

panels.title: Model Combination Effectiveness
panels.description: Horizontal bar chart of worker+arbiter combos ranked by quality, with consensus and synergy overlays.

panels.title: Cost vs Quality Efficiency
panels.description: XY scatter of avg cost vs avg quality per model, point size scaled by sample count. Identifies best value models.

annotations.summary: Average quality has dropped below 50% in the last hour
annotations.description: The average quality score across all models is {{ $value | humanize }} (threshold: 0.5)

annotations.summary: Hourly cost is more than 2x the 24-hour average
Error rate exceeds 20% in the last 30 minutes

prometheus_metrics_reference.description: Expected Prometheus metrics that this dashboard queries. A custom exporter should expose these from learning.db.

ai_learning_cost_usd.help: Current average cost per execution in USD

ai_learning_duration_seconds.help: Current average execution duration in seconds

ai_learning_tuning_quality.help: Tuned average quality for model/task combo

ai_learning_tuning_cost_usd.help: Tuned average cost for model/task combo

ai_learning_tuning_success_rate.help: Tuned success rate for model/task combo

ai_learning_tuning_sample_count.help: Number of samples used for tuning

ai_learning_tuning_updated_timestamp.help: Unix timestamp of last tuning update

setup_instructions.step_1_prometheus: Ensure Prometheus is running at http://localhost:9090
setup_instructions.step_2_exporter: Deploy a custom exporter that reads learning.db and exposes ai_learning_* metrics (see prometheus_metrics_reference section for full metric spec)

step_3_add_datasource.navigate: Configuration > Data Sources > Add data source
step_3_add_datasource.name: Prometheus

step_4_import_dashboard.method: Paste the 'dashboard' object from this JSON file
step_4_import_dashboard.note: Strip __meta, setup_instructions, alert_rules, and prometheus_metrics_reference keys; Grafana ignores them harmlessly

setup_instructions.step_5_configure_alerts: Create Grafana alert rules from the alert_rules section using Contact Points and Notification Policies
